system.name: TOPF (Topological Point Features)
system.one_liner: Computes per-point topological features of a point cloud from persistent-homology generators, projected to harmonic space and averaged over incident simplices.

content.variant_note: one toy point cloud redrawn under four big numerals, entering from a grey Input and leaving as a coloured Output, with an Applications inset
content.argues: Loop generators from persistent homology can be turned into point-level features, one colour per topological feature, that carry global shape information to every point.
content.subject: A toy point cloud, a square loop with three small corner loops, followed through four algorithm steps to per-point feature vectors.

elements.name: Input
elements.role: point cloud X in n-dimensional space: here a square-shaped loop with three small loops at its corners
elements.drawn_as: grey dot cloud with a bold title inside the square

elements.name: Applications
elements.role: downstream uses: Topological Node Embeddings in Biology, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, etc.
elements.drawn_as: grey box with a navy outline, bold title, two sample pictures and a three-line caption

elements.name: 1 Compute persistent homology
elements.role: persistent homology of an alpha/VR filtration, shown as a barcode whose bars correspond to loops in the point cloud
elements.drawn_as: big numeral, two-line caption under a coloured barcode

elements.name: Bars correspond to loops in the point cloud
elements.role: reads the barcode: one bar per loop

elements.name: 2 Pick significant generators
elements.role: selects the most significant features and computes their homology generators
elements.drawn_as: big numeral, caption under a cloud with coloured loop outlines

elements.name: 3 Weighted harmonic representatives
elements.role: projects the generators to the harmonic space of a simplicial complex, optionally weighted
elements.drawn_as: big numeral, caption under a coloured wire mesh of the complex

elements.name: 4 Average over incident simplices
elements.role: for every point, averages the normalised vector entries of the simplices containing it
elements.drawn_as: big numeral, caption under four faded copies of the cloud

elements.name: Output
elements.role: the same cloud coloured by feature values; the output is a |X| x |F| matrix for downstream ML
elements.drawn_as: coloured dot cloud with a bold title inside the square

elements.name: Feature vectors
elements.role: feature vectors of four sample points, one per region of the cloud, rows 1 to 4
elements.drawn_as: four light-grey blocks of four horizontal bars each, with the caption Feature vectors

lessons.what_to_learn: Follow one toy object through the algorithm, redrawing it under a big numeral at each step, and give each selected feature one colour that runs from the first schematic result to the final output vectors. Close with curved arrows from output regions to their feature-vector bars.
lessons.suits: Algorithms that transform one geometric object step by step (topological, geometric, graph methods) where a toy example makes the pipeline self-explanatory.

sections: 3 How to Compute Topological Point Features (p.4)
evidence: Input. A point cloud X in n-dimensional space.
The homology generators are projected to the harmonic space.
The output is a |X| × |F| matrix which can be used for downstream ML tasks.

summary: TOPF computes point-level topological features for a point cloud. Figure 1 follows one toy cloud, a square-shaped loop with three small loops at its corners, through four numbered steps along the bottom: persistent homology drawn as a barcode, the significant generators outlined in colour, weighted harmonic representatives drawn as a coloured simplicial mesh, and averaging over incident simplices drawn as four faded copies, one per feature. Input sits at top left as a grey cloud and Output at top right as the same cloud coloured by feature, with bar blocks for the feature vectors of four sample points. Big hollow arrows lead in and out, an Applications inset shows two sample point clouds, and one colour per feature runs through the whole figure.
summary_zh: TOPF 为点云计算逐点的拓扑特征。图一用一个带三个小环的方形玩具点云贯穿四个编号步骤：持续同调条形码、按颜色标出的显著生成元、加权调和代表网格、对关联单纯形取平均，最终得到按特征着色的输出点云与特征向量条形图。
notes: Prior state-snapshots variant kept. The Applications box is treated as an inset, not a panel, so panel_count is 1. Colour-to-feature mapping is read from the bar rows (1 blue, 2 green, 3 orange, 4 red) and from the step-4 thumbnails. The Output renders look computed rather than drawn, so real_values is true. The two Applications pictures are not explained in the supplied text.
